items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Emmett Berry, George Stevenson, Herbie Hall, Sammy Price, Pops Foster, Fred Moore.

ctx.x: Same band, yeah. Emmett Berry, George Stevenson, Herbie Hall, Sammy Price, Pops Foster, Fred Moore. A series of recordings made between December 1955, January 1956, and February 1956. Well, we don't have them. We'll have to see if we can track some of those recordings down and put them on tape for you. It may, of course, take a while.
